header: Results after one year in use
lead: The figures come from the sites, not from us. Each is the median of 34 organisations, comparing their first month with their twelfth.
note: Sites with fewer than 15 employees are excluded. At that size, one long-term absence changes the figures more than anything we do.

metrics.title: Less time on planning
metrics.text: Last week is copied forward, and rules are checked while you move a shift.

metrics.title: Fewer unplanned overtime hours
metrics.text: Wage cost shown against the branch budget before the week is published.

metrics.title: Faster month-end close
metrics.text: Approved hours exported straight to payroll instead of being retyped.
